purpose: Part 1/4 of verified dynamic 100-record item effect batch 011; together these files contain exactly 100 self-contained reviewed records.

items/unicorn-horn-592.name: Unicorn Horn
items/unicorn-horn-592.effectSummary: The unicorn's horn functions as a +3 magic weapon while attached; its magic fades if the horn is removed from the unicorn.

items/web-choker.name: Web Choker (Drow)
items/web-choker.effectSummary: The wearer can detach and throw each of the choker's nine spheres up to 70 feet; each sphere bursts into a web effect (DC 14). After all nine are used, the choker becomes nonmagical.

items/shaundakuls-boots.name: Shaundakul's Boots
items/shaundakuls-boots.effectSummary: The boots increase base speed by 10 feet. Once per day the wearer can double their unmodified base speed for 5 minutes, and once per tenday can use find the path.

items/drums-marching-384.name: Drums of Marching
items/drums-marching-384.effectSummary: During overland movement, a performer who succeeds on a DC 15 Perform (percussion instruments) check grants allies within 120 feet a +4 bonus on Constitution checks against nonlethal damage from a forced march; playing does not reduce the performer's speed.

items/nipple-clamp-of-exquisite-pain.name: Nipple Clamp of Exquisite Pain
items/nipple-clamp-of-exquisite-pain.effectSummary: The wearer is immune to debilitating pain effects such as circle of nausea and wrack, though not to actual damage merely described as painful. Pain is experienced as pleasure instead, without changing any damage taken.

items/skullcap-of-eyes.name: Skullcap Of Eyes
items/skullcap-of-eyes.effectSummary: The wearer gains +5 competence on Spot checks and enemies gain no flanking bonus against them. If the wearer has Improved Uncanny Dodge, the level an opponent needs to flank them increases by 2.

items/fearsome-57.name: Fearsome
items/fearsome-57.effectSummary: Three times per day, activating the armor or shield creates a 20-foot fear aura for 1 round. Creatures in the area become panicked, or shaken instead on a successful DC 16 Will save.

items/burnoose-of-moonless-nights.name: Burnoose of Moonless Nights
items/burnoose-of-moonless-nights.effectSummary: Three times per day while in darkness or shadowy illumination, the wearer can gain total concealment for 10 rounds without revealing their location by attacking. Bright light suppresses the effect and reveals the wearer.

items/necklace-of-acid-pearls.name: Necklace of Acid Pearls
items/necklace-of-acid-pearls.effectSummary: The seven pearls can be detached and thrown up to 50 feet, each creating an acid storm. One pearl deals 9d6 damage, two deal 7d6, two deal 5d6, and two deal 3d6; Reflex DC 19 halves the damage.

items/wind-fan.name: Wind Fan
items/wind-fan.effectSummary: Once per day the fan can safely create a gust of wind effect. Each additional use that day has a cumulative 20% chance of tearing the fan into useless nonmagical tatters.

items/iron-maiden-of-preservation.name: Iron Maiden of Preservation
items/iron-maiden-of-preservation.effectSummary: A creature confined inside takes 1d6 damage from the spikes each round and simultaneously heals 1d6 damage, but only damage caused by those spikes is healed.

items/returning-156.name: Returning
items/returning-156.effectSummary: A thrown returning weapon flies back just before the thrower's next turn and can be caught as a free action. If the thrower has moved or cannot catch it, the weapon falls in the square from which it was thrown.

items/skillful-506.name: Skillful
items/skillful-506.effectSummary: A skillful melee weapon can be wielded without nonproficiency penalties. When attacking with it, the wielder's base attack bonus is treated as at least three-quarters their character level, without improving attacks made with other weapons.

items/gloves-of-arrow-snaring.name: Gloves of Arrow Snaring
items/gloves-of-arrow-snaring.effectSummary: While both gloves are worn and at least one hand is free, the wearer functions as though they had Deflect Arrows, except they catch thrown weapons and projectiles rather than merely deflecting them.

items/waterskin-of-deluge.name: Waterskin of Deluge
items/waterskin-of-deluge.effectSummary: Once per week, squeezing the opened waterskin releases a flashflood effect. Destroying the waterskin also releases one final flash flood in the direction from which the destructive damage came.

items/incense-of-the-gorgon.name: Incense of the Gorgon
items/incense-of-the-gorgon.effectSummary: When burned, the incense fills a 10-foot cube with dense smoke for a short time. A creature in the smoke that is not holding its breath must make Fortitude DC 19 or be petrified as by flesh to stone.

items/water-wheels.name: Water Wheels
items/water-wheels.effectSummary: A vehicle fitted with all four wheels floats on water regardless of its normal construction, though open vehicles can still become waterlogged. The wheels provide no propulsion, so the vehicle must be rowed, sailed, magically propelled, or pulled by swimming creatures.

items/sling-496.name: Sling
items/sling-496.effectSummary: A sling adds the wielder's Strength modifier to damage. It can be fired one-handed but requires two hands and a move action to load, provoking attacks of opportunity; ordinary stones deal damage as one size smaller and impose -1 on attack rolls.

items/ghost-touch-148.name: Ghost Touch
items/ghost-touch-148.effectSummary: A ghost touch weapon damages incorporeal creatures normally and ignores their usual 50% miss chance. It can be handled by incorporeal creatures and is treated as corporeal or incorporeal whenever that is more beneficial to its wielder.

items/sovereign-sealant.name: Sovereign Sealant
items/sovereign-sealant.effectSummary: One drum treats a Huge boat or container, or two hull sections of a larger vessel. Treated wood gains +2 hardness and becomes waterproof, and a treated ship can lose one additional hull section before sinking.

items/forgehome-standard.name: Forgehome Standard
items/forgehome-standard.effectSummary: Allies within 30 feet gain +2 dodge AC against attacks by giants and +2 on morale checks while at least one enemy giant is visible; the AC bonus stacks with the dwarven dodge bonus against giants.

items/icy-strand-north-414.name: Icy Strand of The North
items/icy-strand-north-414.effectSummary: The cord holds six throwable ice crystals with an 80-foot range: two opaque crystals create sleet storm and four transparent crystals create ice storm, each centered where the crystal lands.

items/headband-of-idiocy.name: Headband of Idiocy
items/headband-of-idiocy.effectSummary: Putting on the headband immediately imposes a -10 penalty to Intelligence and Wisdom, to a minimum score of 3, and causes loss of spells and magical knowledge derived from those abilities. It can be removed only with remove curse.

items/ring-counterspells-67.name: Ring of Counterspells
items/ring-counterspells-67.effectSummary: The ring stores one spell of 1st through 6th level solely for countering. If that same spell is cast on the wearer, it is automatically countered with no action required and the stored spell is expended; another spell can then be stored.

items/robe-of-blending.name: Robe of Blending
items/robe-of-blending.effectSummary: The robe grants +15 circumstance on Hide checks and lets the wearer alter their appearance at will as disguise self/change self; friendly creatures familiar with the wearer continue to see their normal appearance.
